kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتحايل (form VI)
# نَتَحَايَلُ (nataḥāyalu) /na.ta.ħaː.ja.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَحَايَلَ (taḥāyala)
# نَتَحَايَلَ (nataḥāyala) /na.ta.ħaː.ja.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَحَايَلَ (taḥāyala)
# نَتَحَايَلْ (nataḥāyal) /na.ta.ħaː.jal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَحَايَلَ (taḥāyala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
